paper_title: OpenVTON-Bench: A Large-Scale High-Resolution Benchmark for Controllable Virtual Try-On Evaluation
reason: OpenVTON-Bench는 약 10만 쌍(99,925쌍)의 고해상도 가상 피팅(VTON) 이미지 벤치마크이고, 공식 코드·데이터 링크(github.com/RenxingIntelligence/OpenVTON-Bench)도 PDF에 나와 있다. 그러나 핵심 과제는 이미지 생성이라 한국어·영어 중 어느 언어의 과제인지 PDF 본문만으로는 확인되지 않는다. Gemini 캡션 프롬프트와 Qwen-VL-Plus 심사 프롬프트의 전문은 저장소에만 있고, PDF에는 속성 범주를 서술한 설명뿐이다. 논문 서술 언어로 과제 언어를 추정할 수 없으므로 '언어' 근거로 쓸 인용문이 없다. 이 근거가 없으면 한국어·영어 범위 해당 여부와 ko/en 트랙을 정할 수 없어 행을 제안하지 않는다. 프롬프트 원문이나 캡션 예시를 확인하면 vision 모달리티의 en 트랙 후보로 다시 검토할 수 있다.

screening.paper_title: OpenVTON-Bench: A Large-Scale High-Resolution Benchmark for Controllable Virtual Try-On Evaluation
screening.abstract: Recent advances in diffusion models have significantly elevated the visual fidelity of Virtual Try-On (VTON) systems, yet reliable evaluation remains a persistent bottleneck. Traditional metrics struggle to quantify fine-grained texture details and semantic consistency, while existing datasets fail to meet commercial standards in scale and diversity. We present OpenVTON-Bench, a large-scale benchmark comprising approximately 100K high-resolution image pairs (up to $1536\times1536$). The dataset combines Gemini-powered dense captioning with stratified sampling across 20 visual clusters obtained by DINOv3 K-Means. To support reliable evaluation, we propose a multi-modal protocol that measures VTON quality along five interpretable dimensions: background consistency, identity fidelity, texture fidelity, shape plausibility, and overall realism. The protocol integrates VLM-based semantic reasoning with a novel Multi-Scale Representation Metric based on SAM3 segmentation and morphological erosion, enabling the separation of boundary alignment errors from internal texture artifacts. Under the specified evaluation rubric, our representation metric shows strong agreement with human model rankings (Kendall's $τ$ of 0.833 vs. 0.611 for SSIM). Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/RenxingIntelligence/OpenVTON-Bench.
